Split Multi-Omics Data into Training and Test Sets

Source: R/import_data.R
split_train_test.Rd

Identifies the common sample set across all omics layers, performs a single stratified random split on that common set, and returns the raw matrices partitioned into training and test subsets. This ensures every patient lands in the same split across all omics layers, which is a prerequisite for multi-omics survival analysis.

Usage

split_train_test(omics_list, clinical_data, train_fraction = 0.7, seed = 4820)

Arguments

omics_list

Named list of raw omics matrices (features as rows, samples as columns). Matrices do not need to share the same samples beforehand — the intersection is computed internally.

clinical_data

Matrix or data frame of clinical data (variables as rows, samples as columns). Must contain "overall_survival" and "status" rows, and must cover all common samples.

train_fraction

Numeric value in (0, 1) specifying the proportion of common samples to assign to training. Default is 0.7.

seed

Integer seed for reproducibility. Default is 4820.

Value

A named list with:

  • train_ids: Character vector of training sample IDs.

  • test_ids: Character vector of test sample IDs.

  • train_list: Named list of raw matrices subset to training samples (same names as omics_list).

  • test_list: Named list of raw matrices subset to test samples.

  • train_clinical: Clinical data matrix subset to training samples (variables as rows, samples as columns).

  • test_clinical: Clinical data matrix subset to test samples.

Details

The split is performed once on the intersection of all sample sets and then applied identically to every omic layer and to clinical_data. This guarantees that:

  • No patient appears in training for one omic and test for another.

  • build_MAE on the resulting train/test lists will not drop any additional samples when computing the common set.

Samples present in some but not all omics are silently excluded from both splits. A message reports the common sample count and how many samples were excluded per layer.

prepare_RNA, prepare_test_SE, build_MAE
